messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — I ran the onboarding sweep for llama3-13B int8 (quant w/ per-channel) on h100 and a100 across us-east, us-west, eu-west. p50s are close but eu-west p95 is ~260ms higher than us-east. dumping short result snapshot below.

bench-bot: ```region,p50_ms,p95_ms,throughput_tok_s
us-east,32,120,850
us-west,36,145,820
eu-west,40,380,780
```

liam: Oof, eu-west p95 gap looks symptomatic of an extra network hop or proxy backpressure. Any tracing ids for a sample request?

maya: trace: 01f3b2c9-eu-77. sample span shows edge-proxy -> aggregator -> model-host instead of direct edge-host route. Also noticed kernel fallback lines in logs: `attn_fused_v2 not available, falling back to attn_v1` on some hosts in eu-west.

eva-ops: That fallback + extra hop explains both latency and throughput drop. The fallback raises token compute ~1.4x. On infra side, eu-west edge-proxy queues spike during warmup (cache miss). Two quick mitigations: enable prefix KV caching for that model in eu-west; pin model-serving to `attn_fused_v2` capable hosts (h100 pool) and increase `max_batch_ms` to 8ms for smoother batching.

kai: If we shift routing to prefer local pop (geo_priority) for that model, what's the capacity impact? Rough numbers: currently reserved 24 h100 slots eu-west; with geo_priority to remove cross-pop hops we'd get p95 down ~180ms but need +6 slots to maintain same throughput at peak. Is that what you see, maya?

maya: Yeah roughly. Quick calc from loadgen: at target qps, eu-west needs 30 total concurrency vs 24 current -> +6 h100 slots. Expected cost delta ~ +18% on reserved. Also note a100 hosts show larger p95 variance due to kernel fallbacks.

liam: Plan suggestion: 1) small canary: flip routing to geo_priority for 10% of traffic in eu-west for 30m, 2) pin canary to fused kernels (h100 pool), 3) enable KV prefix caching for that route, 4) monitor p50/p95 + error rate. If metrics look good, promote rollout and request +6 slots from capacity team.

bench-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started for route=llama3-13B-int8, region=eu-west, percent=10 at 2160010200.

maya: Kicking off loadgen now (ramp to target qps over 5m). Will paste final numbers and traces here after 30m. Thanks! :thumbsup:
